top_violation_types.title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))
Mark Cleaning Supplies, Toxic Materials; Keep Separate from Food and Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3407(12))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A cleaning bottle was not labeled in a classroom with children present.

top_violation_types.title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Two caregivers did not know how many children they were responsible for.

top_violation_types.title: Measurement of Use Zone for Slides - in Front of Access and on Sides (26 TAC §746.4805(a))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The use zone for the slides lacked the required perimeter.

top_violation_types.title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported.

top_violation_types.title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Transportation training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(7)(A))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Director did not have a current transportation training.

top_violation_types.title: Safety - Electrical Outlets Covered (26 TAC §746.3701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The school age building still had a broken electrical outlet in the library center.

top_violation_types.title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: During the walk through a trash can with food waste was observed in reach of children and accessible.
